# Row-level error diagnosis (executor X)

**Provenance.** Run `dev100_qwen35_4b_img_only_2abf481` (Qwen3.5-4B image-only, keyed JSON), generated by `uv run python scripts/row_error_diagnosis.py` (repo state `8767530+dirty`; ORACLE bootstrap 2000 doc-level paired resamples, seed 42). Every number is computed from the run's `predictions.json` / `trace.jsonl`, the gold labels, the OCR cache and the unmodified official scorer (`assignment/score.py` via `shipdoc.eval`). **All numbers UNVERIFIED** until a verifier recomputes them. Aggregates and counts only: no gold or predicted values, no names; value-level examples are in the local, outside-repo `<SHIPDOC_RUNS_DIR>/diagnosis/row_errors_local.md`.

## X1. row_missing / row_extra

### X1.0 Recount

`eval.error_taxonomy` (the respike definition) gives row_missing 154, row_extra 150, row_split_merge 0. Recomputed here from `eval._pair_rows` (the scorer's own two greedy passes): unpaired gold rows 154, unpaired predicted rows 150, over 77 invoice docs (924 gold rows, 920 predicted rows). Match: True. Docs with a truncated / invalid page: 0.

Concentration: the unpaired gold rows sit in 31 docs; the 5 docs with the most account for 86 of 154 (55.8%).

### X1.1 Breakdown (unpaired rows / all rows of the bucket)

`page position`: `only` = single-page doc, `first` / `middle` / `last` = page of a multipage doc (`middle` = a continuation page that is not the last). A gold row's page is the locator's row-to-page assignment (`locate.assign_rows` + `trainset.resolve_row_pages`, read-only); a predicted row's page is the trace page it was parsed from (replay of `merge_pages`' row loop). `near boundary` = first / last 3 rows of the page (gold order for gold rows, predicted order for predicted rows). Unpaired = left unpaired by the scorer's matching; a gold row and a predicted row of one wrongly read line are both counted, so the two columns are not independent.

## X2. cpn / po null-status mismatches of paired rows

Scorer-paired invoice rows (full + partial pairs) with a customer_part_number / purchase_order null-status mismatch: 67. By kind: cpn_false_fill 8, cpn_over_null 4, mixed 1, po_in_cpn_slot 52, po_over_null 2. Kinds: `po_in_cpn_slot` = gold cpn empty, predicted cpn equals the gold PO, predicted PO empty; `cpn_false_fill` / `po_false_fill` = gold empty, prediction filled; `cpn_over_null` / `po_over_null` = gold filled, prediction empty; `mixed` = both fields differ in null status in another way.

Per supplier group (every group with a mismatch, plus every group whose layout has a PO column but no customer-part column; layout columns from the gold of train+dev pooled: `not printed` = every gold row of the group has that column empty, a group-wide layout constant per recon; the last two columns = dev docs of the group whose OCR table-header line names a customer-part / a PO column, over dev docs with a detected header line):

| group | paired rows | mismatch rows | po_in_cpn_slot | other mismatches | cpn column (gold) | po column (gold) | OCR header names cpn col | OCR header names po col |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| inv_g03 | 27 | 3 | 0 | 3 | printed | not printed | 5/5 | 0/5 |
| inv_g05 | 17 | 1 | 0 | 1 | not printed | printed | 0/2 | 2/2 |
| inv_g06 | 38 | 8 | 0 | 8 | not printed | printed | 0/4 | 4/4 |
| inv_g09 | 94 | 1 | 0 | 1 | printed | printed | 7/7 | 7/7 |
| inv_g12 | 54 | 0 | 0 | 0 | not printed | printed | 0/8 | 8/8 |
| inv_g17 | 7 | 6 | 6 | 0 | not printed | printed | 0/2 | 2/2 |
| inv_g18 | 48 | 48 | 46 | 2 | not printed | printed | 0/3 | 3/3 |

The mismatches that are not `po_in_cpn_slot`, by group and kind: inv_g03 cpn_over_null 3, inv_g05 po_over_null 1, inv_g06 cpn_false_fill 8, inv_g09 cpn_over_null 1, inv_g18 mixed 1, inv_g18 po_over_null 1.

`po_in_cpn_slot` rows: 52 (6 scanned, 46 digital) in 2 groups (inv_g17, inv_g18); groups whose gold layout prints NO customer-part column: 2 of 2; groups whose layout prints a PO column: 2 of 2; rows in a group without a customer-part column: 52 of 52. In these groups there is no customer-part column to read, so the model fills a column that does not exist: it writes the PO value into the cpn slot and leaves the PO slot empty.

Groups with the SAME layout class (PO column, no customer-part column) in dev and no `po_in_cpn_slot` row: inv_g05, inv_g06, inv_g12 (inv_g05: 17 paired rows, inv_g06: 38 paired rows, inv_g12: 54 paired rows). So the missing customer-part column is necessary-looking but NOT sufficient: the error is concentrated in the groups listed above.

Mixed groups (column printed on some rows only): 0.

Format shapes (digits -> 9, letters -> A) in the TRAIN gold: 2 cpn shapes, 2 PO shapes, 0 shared; 2 cpn-only and 2 PO-only shapes (basis of candidate rule R3).

## X4. Cause -> fix class -> ORACLE recoverable points

ORACLE replay (**ORACLE upper bound, not achievable**): the rows / cells of the cause are replaced by gold (pairs: the predicted row becomes the gold row; gold-only rows are appended; predicted-only rows are removed; slot mismatches get the gold cpn / po; waybill over-nulls get the gold value), then the unmodified scorer rescores the 100 dev docs. Delta = OVERALL points vs the run's 76.78; CI = paired doc-level bootstrap (2000 resamples, seed 42). Effects are NOT additive (OVERALL is a mean of per-doc scores and row F1 is a ratio); the combined rows are computed, not summed. Causes with zero rows are listed in X1.3 and have no ORACLE row.

| cause | n rows / cells | scanned / digital | fix class | recoverable OVERALL points [95% CI] (ORACLE upper bound, not achievable) | confidence in the classification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| rows: spn_copies_other_slot | 17 gold / 17 pred (1 docs) | 0 / 17 | fine-tune target (single doc; the gold part number is in the OCR text) | +0.74 [+0.00, +2.47] | low: one doc, mechanism unknown |
| rows: column_shift | 65 gold / 65 pred (7 docs) | 41 / 24 | multi-page context strategy (column order of page 1 given to continuation pages) + fine-tune target (continuation-page rows) | +2.82 [+0.65, +5.50] | medium: most shifts sit on header-less continuation pages and the contrast holds inside supplier groups, but 7 docs, 13 shifts sit on pages with a header row, and the mechanism (missing column header) is inferred from OCR layout, not seen |

Sum of the 13 single-cause deltas above = +15.06 pts vs the combined ORACLE +16.64 pts: the gap (+1.58) is the non-additivity (a doc's OVERALL has a fully-correct component, so fixing the last wrong cell of a doc is worth more than its cell share).

### Candidate merge-rule replays (achieved on dev, unmodified scorer, NOT oracles)

Four rules that follow from the findings above, replayed one at a time on the run's predictions. They are NOT upper bounds: they use only the model output, the OCR text and (R3) format shapes learned from TRAIN gold. R1 and R2 were designed after looking at the dev over-nulls, so their dev numbers are optimistic; R2's precision is also checked on all train+dev waybills in X3. `touched` = cells / rows the rule changed; `fixed` = wrong before, right after; `broken` = right before, wrong after.

| rule | touched | fixed | broken | wrong after | d OVERALL pts [95% CI] | d row F1 pts | d header acc pts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R1 waybill carrier <- own supplier_name slot | 4 | 4 | 0 | 0 | +0.59 [+0.05, +1.39] | +0.00 | +0.49 |
| R2 waybill mawb / hawb <- unique OCR pattern match | 12 | 12 | 0 | 0 | +1.98 [+0.85, +3.37] | +0.00 | +1.46 |
| R3 cpn <-> po slot swap by format shape (shapes from train gold) | 54 | 52 | 0 | 2 | +2.66 [+0.48, +5.68] | +5.64 | +0.00 |
| R4 part number <- nearest OCR span when absent from OCR | 86 | 39 | 28 | 47 | +0.10 [-1.60, +1.78] | +0.76 | +0.00 |

Mechanisms (one line per cause):

- `spn_misread`: the part number is the right line read with 1-2 wrong characters (see the edit profile in X1.3); the model, not the OCR layout, is the weak reader here and the OCR text is wrong too in a part of the cases, so snapping to it breaks as many rows as it fixes.
- `column_shift`: cpn / po / part-number values land one slot to the left or right; concentrated on continuation pages that carry no column-header row, where the model has to guess the column order.
- `spn_copies_other_slot`: the part-number slot is filled with the PO value of the same row (one doc, 17 rows), although the gold part number is readable in the OCR text.
- `page_short`: a page yields fewer rows than the gold page holds (one doc).
- `slot:po_in_cpn_slot`: layouts without a customer-part column: the PO value is written into the customer_part_number slot and purchase_order is left empty.
- `header:mawb`: the model emits a null mawb although MAWB value and label are on the page and in the OCR text; mostly scanned pages.
- `header:carrier`: the carrier is the letterhead company name (no 'carrier' label on any waybill); the model writes it into the invoice-schema supplier_name slot, which the merge drops.
- `header:hawb`: the model emits a null hawb although value and label are in the OCR text (scanned pages).
